Definition: properly, assemblage; used only adverbially also, even, yea, though; often repeated as correl. both... and
BiblicalUsage: 1) also, even, indeed, moreover, yea; 1a) also, moreover (giving emphasis); 1b) neither, neither...nor (with negative); 1c) even (for stress); 1d) indeed, yea (introducing climax); 1e) also (of correspondence or retribution); 1f) but, yet, though (adversative); 1g) even, yea, yea though (with 'when' in hypothetical case); 2) (TWOT) again, alike
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
